architecture_note: Strategy strategy_strategy_draft.txt §1 and §3 require routes EI (E AND I AND T) and EO (E AND O AND T) to be run and exported SEPARATELY, combined only after dedup ("Export the EI and EO result sets separately before deduplication"). search_log_template.json has no single-route 'union' search entry; PUBMED_EI and PUBMED_EO are the two formal entries.
